name: OpenClaw Direct
postCreateCommand: sudo npm install -g openclaw@latest && mkdir -p /workspaces/oc_direct/.openclaw_data && ln -sfn /workspaces/oc_direct/.openclaw_data ~/.openclaw
postStartCommand: if [ -f /workspaces/oc_direct/.env ] && [ -f /workspaces/oc_direct/.openclaw_data/openclaw.json ]; then export $(grep -v '^#' /workspaces/oc_direct/.env | xargs) && openclaw gateway run > /tmp/openclaw_boot.log 2>&1 & echo '🚀 OpenClaw Gateway started in background.'; else echo '👋 Welcome! Setup required: 1. Create .env file 2. Run: openclaw onboard'; fi
